Destinations

Where we take you

Rome & around

Rome, Tivoli (Villa d’Este, Hadrian’s Villa), Ostia Antica, Cerveteri, Calcata, Castel Gandolfo, Nemi, Castelli Romani.

Umbria & Tuscia

Orvieto, Assisi, Viterbo, Civita di Bagnoregio, Lake Bolsena.

Tuscany

Siena, San Gimignano and a vineyard visit; Florence for art lovers.

Sea & islands

Anzio, Santa Marinella, Sperlonga, Gaeta, Circeo, Ponza.

Winter, December to March

Snow, 1.5 to 2 hours from Rome

Skiing, snowboarding, sledding, snow tubing and snowshoe walks.

Monte Livata

About 75 km from Rome. Small resort, snowshoe trails, good for families.

Terminillo & Campo Staffi

About 100 km. “Rome’s mountain” with ski schools, a snowpark, sledding and tubing.

Campo Felice, Ovindoli & more

About 110 km and beyond: bigger slopes, Campo Imperatore, Roccaraso for a weekend.

Stay with us

Sleep where the tours start

Multi-day packages can include a stay at Villa Nomentum in Mentana, 25 km from Rome: three apartments with kitchen, 18 beds and a garden. Available also without a tour, for short and long stays.

See the villa

Plan your trip

Tell us when you travel, how many you are and what you want to see. We reply with a package and a quote.
